name: Elena Torres
bio: Former VP of Engineering at two venture-backed startups. Elena leads delivery and makes sure every engagement starts with honest scoping — and ends with a reference, not just an invoice.

name: Daniel Kim
bio: Fifteen years building distributed systems across fintech and healthcare. Daniel still reviews architecture on every project and leads our technical audit practice personally.

name: Marcus Webb
bio: Product designer of twelve years with a research background. Marcus believes the best interface decisions are made watching real users, not debating in conference rooms.

name: Priya Nair
bio: AWS certified architect with a FinOps specialty. Priya has led migrations moving millions of dollars of annual infrastructure spend — usually downward.

name: Sofia Ramos
bio: TypeScript enthusiast and CI/CD perfectionist. Sofia has shipped production software in six industries and brings testing discipline wherever she lands.

name: Tomás Ferreira
bio: Runs our Lisbon hub and keeps distributed pods humming across time zones. Tomás's superpower is making weekly demos something clients look forward to.

name: Hannah Cole
bio: Design-system specialist who has built component libraries adopted by teams of fifty-plus engineers. Hannah prototypes in code to keep handoff friction near zero.

name: Omar Haddad
bio: PMP-certified delivery lead who has run engagements from six-week audits to multi-year platform programs. Omar owns the part clients notice most: no surprises.
